acceptance_criteria.text: Given a host calls the unified context-assembly API, When the request does not name any individual zone, Then the Orchestrator resolves and returns assembled context sourced from the correct zones without the host needing zone-level knowledge.

invest.independent: Delivers the routing facade as its own deployable surface.
invest.negotiable: Concrete routing algorithm is an implementation choice.
invest.valuable: Gives the host the single unified integration API.
invest.estimable: Facade pattern and API surface fully specified in HLD Section 3.1.
invest.small: Scoped to routing + API surface only.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a host session writes to Working Memory, When the item's TTL expires without promotion, Then the item is evicted from Zone 1 without requiring an explicit delete call.

invest.independent: Self-contained zone with its own storage adapter.
invest.negotiable: Concrete backend (in-process LRU vs. Redis) is deployment-profile-specific.
invest.valuable: Highest single-item WSJF in the corrected FR table.
invest.estimable: TTL-primary eviction mechanism is fully specified.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given multiple Episodic entries with distinct timestamps, When the host queries Zone 2 by recency, Then results are returned in strict chronological order and each entry exposes its own decay attribute.

invest.independent: Self-contained zone with its own storage adapter and recency index.
invest.negotiable: Concrete decay function implementation is deployment-tunable.
invest.estimable: Recency ordering and per-entry decay attribute fully specified.

assumes: every FR in SRS.md is implementable within the approved HLD
must_not: introduce stories with no FR traceability
